title: 第13章 惊恐的人面魈

第13章惊恐的人面魈
在人面玉精花开花的时候，所有看向它的人都会被迷住。
包括它自己。
所以当它看向铜镜的一刹那，反而自己陷入了一种迷醉之中。
趁着这个当口，后方的林北抽剑便要割断花茎，只要将此花摘下，便就算任务完成了。
可正当此时，异变陡生！
一道白影倏忽间从天而降，落在了人面玉精花与林北的旁边，出手就是一爪，恶狠狠地抓向林北的咽喉！
迅猛毒辣，一击致命！
亏得林北反应不慢，连忙横剑一挡，铛啷啷一声，剑刃火光四溅，他整个人也倒退了几步。若是稍慢一点，肯定已经被一爪毙命。
外围剑阵三人这才回过身，看清场间落下的，原来是一只身材矮小如孩童、通体呈白玉色、顶着一颗硕大头颅的怪物。
“人面魈！”方霆面色一变，当即出剑。
这极为罕见的怪物，绝不在他的预计之中。
可那怪物动作十分迅疾，击退林北之后反手就折下那开放的一朵人面玉精花，翻身就要逃离此间。
方霆出手也快，惊雷剑上举，左手拈决，顷刻间剑气金龙遍布场间，环绕四周上下，瞬间成了一座剑气囚牢！仿若雷池一般，将那怪物困在中间！
那怪物却丝毫不躲，径直向上一跃，身形忽然透明了一刹那，在那一瞬间里穿过了剑气囚牢，跃上高空，又一脚踏住半空倒挂的岩石，腾跃而起。
不过眨眼功夫，已然远走十数丈！
“妖孽休走！”
方霆顿时气急，翻身踏剑，剑光瞬间化作一道狂暴金龙，疾追上去。
轰轰轰轰！
可这山谷之中怪石倒挂纵横交错，那白影又灵活无比，专挑崎岖前路行进。

御剑的速度虽快，却更偏向直线长距离飞行，这样辗转腾挪并不灵动，飞出不远便撞碎了巨石连连。
若是普通石块一路横冲直撞过去也无所谓，这山谷中的怪石偏偏又极为坚硬。高速御剑之时屡屡重击本就是极为危险的事，即便是方霆这般第四境的修者也有些遭不住。
不过片刻之后，他便身形一转，改为肉身御风前行。而惊雷剑则破空而去，想要直接飞剑隔空将那怪物斩杀。
可这样一来，他的速度就更加迟滞，转眼又被拉开了一大段范围。飞剑追着那无比灵活的怪物，也总是无法锁定。
这一切都在电光火石之间发生，双方行进俱是疾掠如风，不知不觉便已经来到了山谷深处。就在方霆一副身心还放在前方怪物的白影上时，不提防头顶传来隆隆风声，一道粗大的黑影覆盖了下来。
他将身紧急一停，这才发现是一根巨型枝杈！而自己，已经来到了一株通天巨木之前！
原来这山谷中央，有着一棵高不知几十丈的巨树，树冠遮天蔽日延伸开来，似乎这整座山谷的草木都是它衍生的。巨树的身畔环绕着无数粗大的枝杈，只要有活物靠近，都会遭到枝杈的抽击。
显然这尊巨树，就是这片山谷的妖王！
方霆躲过第一根，却没躲过正面而来的第二根，嘭！
这一击，将他身形抽出十余丈远！
翻滚落地之后，方霆再抬头看那怪物的白影，只见它在巨树枝杈的连续抽击中躲闪跳跃，居然片叶不曾沾身。
它太灵活了！
方霆的雷霆剑气向来也是速度见长，可是更加偏大开大合、直来直往。
若是在平坦开阔之处，他自信不出片刻就能将这人面魈抓住。可是在这崎岖复杂的山谷内，他居然奈何不了对方。
又因那巨树存在而不敢再追。
只能看着那怪物的背影转眼间又越跳越远……
“可恶！”方霆怒骂一声。
一个金丹境带队，任务还失败了。这样回山，不知师尊怎么看自己，子阳师兄会怎么看自己，子晴师妹怎么看……嗯？
就在他懊恼的时间，一条肉眼几乎难以捕捉的黑影又瞬间从他身旁掠过，朝那怪物的方向疾追过去。
而且看上去，更加迅速、更加灵活！巨树的枝杈甚至都没有对这道黑影进行攻击，因为它们还没反应过来他就已经过去了！

飒飒飒飒飒！
人面魈。
是一种极为罕见的山中精怪，是在人面玉精花成熟的一刻，恰好被鬼物吞食，那鬼物便会生长出一副新的肉身，称为人面魈。
这种精怪的特点就是速度奇快、灵活无比。
山谷中的这一只，便是一只在此蹲守了良久的人面魈。对于那些敢触碰自己找到的玉精花的人族，它自然是恨不得赶尽杀绝。
可是那些人族的修为又极为强大，它只能抢夺了人面玉精花之后赶紧跑路。只要回到洞穴，将这朵花也炼化，那自己的修为就能强上一倍，到时候……桀桀桀桀桀桀桀……
想到自己修为大增的画面，人面魈不由得发出了一阵怪笑。
至于后面那穷追不舍的人族修者，它心中只有不屑。纵使他修为再强大，也只有跟在自己屁股后面吃灰的份儿。
它对这片山谷了如指掌，可以轻而易举地甩掉他。他居然还想在这里御剑风行，呵呵，等着把脑袋撞烂吧！
等着进入了巨树的笼罩范围，人面魈知道，自己已经安全了。
除了自己，没有第二只妖物能够在巨树的身上自由穿梭。这些人族，更不行！
它自如地闪转腾挪，犹如闲庭信步一般。半晌，他觉得自己可以回头看一眼那人族气急败坏的样子了。因为再远，就看不到了。
这样想着，人面魈怪笑着回过了头。
然后，它那硕大的人面上，一双眼珠突然暴涨，似乎看到了什么极为恐怖的画面！
那是什么？
它并不发达的灵智开始疯狂疑惑。
因为它这一回头，居然看见了自己的正后方，仅仅落后一个身位，居然紧跟着一道黑影。
飒！飒！
一眼的功夫，那道黑影又翔跃到了自己头顶，继而是身侧，与自己并驾齐驱！
怎么可能？！

我这是遇见鬼了？
不对啊，我才是鬼啊！
在它的记忆里，自它出生以来，从没有谁能跟上它人面魈的速度！
这究竟是怎么一回事？
因为都保持着高速运动，它与那道黑影之间反而相对是静止的。因而它也得以看清，那黑影的真实模样。
那是一名锦衣束袖的少年郎，相当俊秀，看上去一副儒雅随和的样子。
他为什么会有这么恐怖的身法？
随着人面魈的目光看过来，那少年也抬眼看向了人面魈。
然后……伸出舌头，舔了舔自己的手掌心……同时眼中精芒湛湛，似乎很享受这种追逐捕猎的感觉。
人面魈脸上的怪笑一下就崩碎了。
妈耶，这是个变态！
content_en:
Chapter 13 The frightened mandrill
When the jade flower blooms, everyone who looks at it will be fascinated.
Including itself.
So when it looked at the bronze mirror, it fell into a kind of intoxication.
Taking advantage of this moment, Lin Bei, who was behind, drew his sword to cut off the flower stem. As long as he plucked the flower, the task was completed.
But at this moment, a sudden change occurred!
A white shadow suddenly fell from the sky and landed next to the human-faced jade essence flower and Lin Bei. It took out a claw and grabbed Lin Bei's throat viciously!
Swift, vicious, and fatal in one blow!
Fortunately, Lin Bei reacted quickly and quickly blocked the attack with his sword. There was a clang, flames flying from the sword, and he took a few steps back. If it had been a little slower, it would have been killed by a claw.
The three people in the peripheral sword formation turned around and saw clearly what fell in the field. It turned out to be a monster as short as a child, with a white jade color and a huge head.
"Human-faced mandrill!" Fang Ting's expression changed and he immediately drew his sword.
This extremely rare monster was definitely not what he expected.
But the monster moved very quickly. After repelling Lin Bei, he broke off the open human-faced jade flower with his backhand and turned around to escape.
Fang Ting was also quick in his attack. He raised the Thunder Sword and held it with his left hand. In an instant, the sword energy golden dragons spread all over the field, surrounding the surroundings, turning it into a sword energy prison! It was like a thunder pool, trapping the monster in the middle!
The monster didn't hide at all, and jumped straight up. Its figure suddenly became transparent for a moment. In that moment, it passed through the sword energy prison, jumped into the sky, stepped on the upside-down rock in mid-air, and leaped into the sky.
But in the blink of an eye, he was already ten feet away!
"Don't leave, monster!"
Fang Ting suddenly became furious, turned over and stepped on his sword. The sword light instantly turned into a violent golden dragon, and he chased after him.
Boom boom boom!
But in this valley, strange rocks hang upside down and are criss-crossed, and the white shadow is extremely flexible, specializing in navigating the rugged road ahead.
Although Yu Jian is fast, he prefers to fly in a straight line and long distances. It is not agile to move around like this, and it smashes into huge rocks after flying not far.
It wouldn't matter if ordinary rocks were rushing all the way, but the strange rocks in the valley were extremely hard. Repeatedly hitting hard while wielding a sword at high speed is extremely dangerous, and even a fourth-level cultivator like Fang Ting can't bear it.
But after a moment, he turned around and moved forward in the wind with his physical body. The Thunder Sword pierced through the air, intending to kill the monster directly through the air with its flying sword.
But as a result, his speed became even more sluggish, and in the blink of an eye he was stretched a large distance. The flying sword chased the extremely flexible monster, but could never lock on to it.
All this happened in a flash of lightning. Both sides were moving as fast as the wind, and before they knew it, they had reached the depths of the valley. Just when Fang Ting was still focused on the white shadow of the monster in front of him, he didn't pay attention to the rumbling wind above his head, and a thick black shadow covered it.
He stopped suddenly and realized that it was a giant branch! And he had already arrived in front of a giant tree that reached the sky!
It turns out that in the center of the valley, there is a giant tree that is dozens of feet tall. The tree crown extends to cover the sky and the sun. It seems that the vegetation in the entire valley is derived from it. The giant tree is surrounded by countless thick branches. As long as any living creature approaches, it will be struck by the branches.
Obviously this giant tree is the demon king of this valley!
Fang Ting dodged the first one, but failed to dodge the second one coming from the front, bang!
This blow pushed his body more than ten feet away!
After rolling to the ground, Fang Ting looked up at the white shadow of the monster, only to see it dodging and jumping among the continuous blows from the giant branches, but not a single leaf touched it.
It's so flexible!
Fang Ting's Thunder Sword Qi has always been good at speed, but it is more open and close, and goes straight forward.
If it were in a flat and open place, he was confident that he would be able to see this person in front of him in no time.Mandrill caught. But in this rugged and complicated valley, he was unable to do anything to the other party.
And because of the presence of the giant tree, he didn't dare to chase anymore.
I can only watch the monster's back jumping further and further away in the blink of an eye...
"Damn it!" Fang Ting cursed angrily.
A Jindan realm leader led the team, but the mission failed. Going back to the mountain like this, I wonder what Master thinks of me, what Senior Brother Ziyang thinks of me, what Junior Sister Ziqing thinks of me...huh?
Just when he was annoyed, a black shadow that was almost difficult to catch with the naked eye passed by him in an instant and chased in the direction of the monster.
And it looks faster and more flexible! The branches of the giant tree didn't even attack the black shadow, because he had already passed by before they could react!
Whistle, rustle, rustle!
Mandrill.
It is an extremely rare mountain spirit. When the human-faced jade essence flower matures and is swallowed by a ghost, the ghost will grow a new body, called a human-faced mandrill.
The characteristics of this kind of monster are its extremely fast speed and extreme flexibility.
This one in the valley is a mandrill that has been squatting here for a long time. It naturally wants to kill all those humans who dare to touch the jade essence flowers it finds.
But the cultivation of those human beings was extremely powerful, so it could only snatch the human-faced jade essence flower and run away quickly. As long as he returns to the cave and refines this flower, his cultivation will be doubled. When the time comes... Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie...
Thinking of the image of his cultivation greatly increased, the mandrill couldn't help but let out a strange laugh.
As for the human cultivators who were chasing after them, it only had disdain in its heart. No matter how powerful his cultivation is, he can only follow his own butt and eat dust.
It knew the valley well and could easily get rid of him. He actually wants to wield a sword here, haha, wait until his head is smashed!
After entering the area covered by the giant tree, the mandrill knew that he was already safe.
Apart from himself, no other monster can freely shuttle around the giant tree. Not even these human races!
It moves around freely, as if strolling in a garden. After a while, he felt that he could look back at the furious look of the human race. Because no matter how far away you are, you can’t see it.
Thinking this, the mandrill monster smiled and turned his head.
Then, on its huge human face, a pair of eyes suddenly swelled, as if it had seen something extremely terrifying!
What is that?
Its underdeveloped mind began to wonder wildly.
Because when it turned around, it actually saw a black shadow directly behind it, just one body behind it.
Sa! Sa!
In the blink of an eye, the black shadow leaped over his head again, and then to his side, keeping pace with him!
How is that possible? !
Did I meet a ghost?
No, I’m the ghost!
In its memory, since its birth, no one has ever been able to keep up with its speed!
What is going on?
Because they were all moving at a high speed, they were relatively stationary to the black shadow. Therefore, it was able to see clearly the true appearance of the black shadow.
He was a young man in brocade clothes and sleeves. He was quite handsome and looked elegant and easy-going.
Why does he have such terrifying movement skills?
Following the mandrill's gaze, the young man also raised his eyes and looked at the mandrill.
Then... he stuck out his tongue and licked the palm of his hand... At the same time, his eyes were shining brightly, as if he was enjoying the feeling of chasing and hunting.
The strange smile on the mandrill's face instantly shattered.
Oh my god, this is a pervert!
